method.prompt: Photorealistic the same narrow alley corner between two dark brick houses at night, snow piled against the walls, a single dim street lamp glowing, the same night, moments later, a barefoot girl of about nine with reddish-gold hair under a patched gray coat, clutching a bundle of matchboxes crouches and strikes a match against the wall. Sudden flare blooms across her face. Macro of the flame catching. Sharp hiss, held breath, then soft crackle, wind dropping away.
